source_text: However, high-quality studies, including a 2023 review in Sexual Medicine Open Access, find no evidence of sexual dysfunction or diminished pleasure post-circumcision, with randomized trials and meta-analyses showing minimal or no adverse impacts on sensation or satisfaction.
